model.name: Under Armour Slipspeed Trainer - Men's
model.description:
You're not like the rest: You stay relentless in your pursuit of peak athletic ability. Get gear that pushes you to perform at that level with the Under Armour Slipspeed Trainer. Packed and powered to help you push past your limitations, these trainers feature the original UA FLOW Cushioning that puts a spring under your step. The BOA Fit system adapts to the contours of your feet and delivers the perfect fit, while the ISO-Chill padded interior keeps your feet cool at all times. Shush your doubters and break personal records in the Under Armour Slipspeed Trainer.

  • Breathable upper maximizes comfort.
  • Convertible heel adds functionality.
  • Weight: 10.8 oz.

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
